newsitem.title: USA: Cinergi Pictures to seek bids on projects.
newsitem.headline: Cinergi Pictures to seek bids on projects.

text.p: Cinergi Pictures Entertainment Inc said Tuesday it instructed its financial advisor, Jefferson Capital Group Ltd., to solicit cash bids from qualified buyers for the purchase of its slate of about 20 wholly owned development projects.

In a statemment, the company said it already received an initial bid for the development projects of $4.75 million, plus the reimbursement of certain of the company's costs related to such projects, from Andrew Vajna, chairman and chief executive of the company.
Additional qualified bids will be required to be at least 15 percent higher than the initial bid, the company said.

Cinergi previously announced it does not currently intend to begin production on any additional motion pictures and that it has entered into an agreement to sell to Walt Disney Co's Pictures and Television unit nearly all of the films in the company's motion picture library and certain other assets.

Cinergi said Disney is in the process of completing its due diligence with respect to that transaction. Any sale of the development projects will be subject, among other things, to completion of the film library sale.

Not included in the slate of development projects for which bids are being solicited are about 20 development projects funded by the company under its "first-look" arrangement with producer/director Oliver Stone and certain of his affiliated entities.
In the event any of these projects are produced by Stone, Stone must reimburse the related actual costs, Cinergi said.
Separately, the company said it is in discussions with News Corp's Twentieth Century Fox regarding the sale to Fox of the company's rights in "Die Hard With A Vengeance."
In addition, the company said it has also entered into negotiations with Vajna about a merger that would follow the film library sale and the sale of all or a portion of the company's other assets.

At the time of such a merger, assuming consummation of the film library sale and the sale of the company's rights with respect to "Die Hard With A Vengeance", the company's assets would consist primarily of cash and the development projects in the event Vajna were to be the prevailing bidder for the development projects.
